'''Rod Latham Ralltiir Universal v3''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds109.htm Ralltiir Universal v3], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
